const ZERO = 0;
const DEBOUNCE_MS = 300;

export async function defer(work: () => void, delay: number) {
  // ruleid: next-frame-call-javascript
  setTimeout(work);
  // ruleid: next-frame-call-javascript
  setTimeout(work, 0);
  // ruleid: next-frame-call-javascript
  window.setTimeout(work, ZERO);
  // ruleid: next-frame-call-javascript
  globalThis.setTimeout(
    () => {
      work();
    },
    0,
  );
  // ruleid: next-frame-call-javascript
  setTimeout(work, 16);
  // ruleid: next-frame-call-javascript
  setImmediate(work);
  // ruleid: next-frame-call-javascript
  requestAnimationFrame(work);
  // ruleid: next-frame-call-javascript
  window.requestAnimationFrame(() => work());
  // ruleid: next-frame-call-javascript
  requestIdleCallback(work, { timeout: 1 });
  // ruleid: next-frame-call-javascript
  queueMicrotask(work);
  // ruleid: next-frame-call-javascript
  process.nextTick(work);
  // ruleid: next-frame-call-javascript
  Promise.resolve().then(work);
  // ruleid: next-frame-call-javascript
  await Promise.resolve();
  // ruleid: next-frame-call-javascript
  await null;
  // ruleid: next-frame-call-javascript
  await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve));
  setTimeout(work, 17);
  setTimeout(work, DEBOUNCE_MS);
  setTimeout(work, 500);
  setTimeout(work, delay);
  await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 250));
  const settled = Promise.resolve(delay);
  await Promise.all([settled]);
  const stopwatch = { setTimeout: (limit: number) => limit };
  stopwatch.setTimeout(1000);
}
